name: tnParserNet
purpose: Parses a tensor-algebra expression: reads its tokens and writes its tree in prefix order, for the exact engine to check and use.
structure: Target (22 tokens); embedding 128; Input (32 tokens); embedding 128; encoder 3 × (4 heads, FF 512 GELU); decoder 3 × (4 heads, FF 512 GELU); softmax per token over 22 (Probabilities)
